verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 93.0 (-3.0% in a day) and momentum is 45: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,100 and 86s 4,800. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-13T21:26:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Khadija Shaw 91 Team of the week after its 76% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 78,000 coins. Now 70,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 76.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 8 of 15 so far, averaging +5.1% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 5,500 coins. Now 4,800. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 5,500 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 3 so far, averaging +19.1% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,100 (1.00 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,800 (1.17 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,500 (1.18 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,000 (1.45 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Jobe Bellingham and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Jobe Bellingham 77 Rare -47.6%; Marcos Llorente 85 Rare -44.8%; Archie Brown 85 Star Performer -40.7%; Corentin Tolisso 84 Team of the week -39.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
